prior_exposure.2015-2017: Historical physical warm-up and parameter derivation; not a blind interval.
prior_exposure.2018-2020: Historical observations and model performance already explored; development validation only.
prior_exposure.2000-2025: Raw USGS coverage/QC and meteorological archives inspected; not proof of untouched data.
prior_exposure.2021-2025: No outcome evaluation found in repository experiment reports or pglocal simulations; reserve until delivery 4.

simulation.coordination: Annual publication runs replay continuously from 2000 with identical arm-specific frozen inputs; no annual storage reset at publication start.
simulation.plant_contract: Derive B on the prespecified calibration year 2010, freeze before TRAIN/VALIDATION, do not regenerate morphology per evaluation year.

calibration.objective: minimum monthly outlet RMSE in CALIBRATION only

second_stage.policy: Use the first-stage winner's ESCO/flo_min; vary tile t_fc only

calibration.candidate_outputs: MONTHLY native SWAT+ outputs and metrics persisted in existing PostgreSQL; playback only for final daily arms
calibration.acceptance_policy: Record failure without extending the budget or claiming a validated baseline; retained winner remains exploratory.
calibration.shared_A_B: All hydrological parameters, soils, weather, drainage, geometry, outlet, engine and publication years
calibration.parameter_scope: Exploratory bounded settings, not observed local hydraulic estimates or a global sensitivity analysis. perco is overridden/excluded for tiled HRUs in this engine.

observations.estimated_policy: Include approved estimated values in primary comparisons; publish exclusion as secondary with recomputed common support.
observations.missing_policy: Never impute observations; simulated and observed monthly means use identical approved paired dates.
observations.test_access: No TEST observation query, export, tuning or metric in deliveries 2 and 3.

monthly_exports.fluxes: sum daily mm over full month; named percolation_mm, never infiltration_mm
monthly_exports.states: mean dated states over full month
monthly_exports.crop_inactive: zero living-crop LAI/root-depth/biomass/transpiration; stress null outside active season, export active_days and stress_available_days
monthly_exports.unknown: null plus availability information; never substitute a biological zero for unknown
monthly_exports.support: Common paired days across A/B for observed/physical monthly Q; full calendar months for model weather/state features. Retrospective monthly inference, not advance forecasting.

simple_references: nonnegative affine physical-Q correction fitted on TRAIN
evaluation.negative_flow_policy: max(0, physical_Q + predicted_residual), same rule for validation and test

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap on common monthly errors

evaluation.decision: H1 supported only if the paired TEST RMSE reduction D versus A has a 95% interval strictly above zero; no obligatory 15% threshold.
evaluation.ml_selection: TRAIN/VALIDATION only; delivery 3 fixes model families and equal search budgets before model training; TEST evaluated once after freezing.

limitations: One basin and fixed experimental management, not historical rotation reconstruction or spatial generalization.
Derived FSPM moisture assumes uniform available-water fraction across soil layers.
2010 plant morphology is a prespecified model-derived contract, not observed or a representative year demonstrated empirically.
External ET/PET products remain process diagnostics, not measured ET targets.
ML can correct outlet errors without validating physiology or preserving water balance.
